canonical_project: Era4 / Carbon3.ai Derbyshire modular AI data centre

location.country: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

notes: Full planning application submitted for a modular data centre at Erin Landfill, Duckmanton, Chesterfield. Trade coverage reports up to five HPE Mod Pods; Computer Weekly reported each pod is capable of 1.5MW and the site is expected to go live in H2 2026. Era4 site states Carbon3.ai rebranded as Era4 on 2026-03-04.
